The fixed circuit ran on garnet:mock with 100 shots. Job 01a15fa2-a06d-77f6-ad44-9f95a85f0539 completed with counts {"00": 55, "11": 45}. Only 00 and 11 came back, which is what a Bell pair should give.

I changed two things.
1. I replaced QB25 with QB2. Garnet has 20 qubits, QB1 to QB20, so QB25 does not exist. The garnet:mock architecture lists QB1-QB2 as a calibrated cz pair, so QB1 can entangle with QB2 directly.
2. I replaced "cx" with native gates. Garnet only accepts prx, cz and measure, so "cx" is an unknown operation there. The CNOT is now three gates. The first is prx(angle=-pi/2, phase=pi/2) on QB2. The second is cz on (QB1, QB2). The third is prx(angle=pi/2, phase=pi/2) on QB2.

I kept the first prx on QB1, which is a Ry(pi/2) and puts QB1 into superposition. The measure step now reads both QB1 and QB2 under key "m". The fixed circuit is in /Users/claytonchancey/Desktop/quantum/.claude/worktrees/wf_3612af23-e49-88/bell_fixed.json.
